The drill-and-fill wall insulation measure leverages the “Insulation Wall” ResStock option that assigns wall assembly R-values and wall types in OS-HPXML. As of ResStock 2024 Release 2, there are 15 different baseline insulation wall options (Reyna, Fontanini and Present, et al. 2024). The ResStock argument definitions set in the Insulation Wall characteristic are reproduced in Table 4, originally from the ResStock Technical Reference Documentation, v3.3.0 Table 46, which details the assumptions for ResStock 2024 (Reyna, Fontanini and Present, et al. 2024). The HVAC-related arguments are modified because of different HVAC capacities, not specifically to model advanced air sealing or drill- and-fill wall insulation. This is not an exhaustive list, and the arguments that change depend on the individual building energy model. The variable values are model dependent, therefore only the names, units, and descriptions are provided. Table 5.
